description: This file contains utility functions for visualizing object detection results, including drawing bounding boxes, labels, and annotations on images. It is part of a larger object detection project, specifically related to RetinaNet detection pipeline.

methods.name: draw_box(image, box, color, thickness=2)
methods.description: Draws a rectangular box on an image with specified color and thickness.

methods.name: draw_caption(image, box, caption)
methods.description: Draws a caption label above a bounding box on the image.

methods.name: draw_boxes(image, boxes, color, thickness=2)
methods.description: Draws multiple bounding boxes on an image.

methods.name: draw_detections(image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshold=0.5)
methods.description: Draws detection boxes along with labels and scores, filtering by score threshold.

methods.name: draw_annotations(image, annotations, color=(0, 255, 0), label_to_name=None)
methods.description: Draws annotation boxes and labels from provided detection data.

ctags.name: draw_detections
ctags.pattern: /^def draw_detections(image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshol/
ctags.signature: (image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshold=0.5)
